# اُنْتُظِرُوا (untuẓirū) /un.tu.ðˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِنْتَظَرَ (intaẓara)
# اِنْتَظِرُوا (intaẓirū) /in.ta.ðˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَظَرَ (intaẓara)
